explanation: The Jacobian matrix is \(\begin{pmatrix}e^u&0&0\\e^{u+w}&0&e^{u+w}\\v&u&1\end{pmatrix}\), whose determinant is \(-u e^{2u+w}\). The exponential is always positive, so the determinant vanishes exactly when u=0. This is the vw-plane.

answers.correct_value: The critical points lie on the $vw-$plane.
